Complete [[Finding the Bloodstone]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Help [[Gadd]] acquire the [[Bloodstone]] from [[Sparkfly Swamp]] on the [[Tarnished Coast]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 1,500 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[Finding the Bloodstone#Walkthrough|Finding the Bloodstone]].
